anomaly_def.Name: Optimizer Statistics Anomaly
anomaly_def.Description: Definition: Root cause located in the optimizer's input metadata, where row counts, value distribution histograms, density information, multi-column correlation, and partition-level statistics no longer represent the actual data distribution, leading to systematic cardinality misestimation. It is distinct from plan selection itself because the failure originates from incorrect costing inputs rather than from the cost model or decision logic. Observable phenomena: large discrepancies between estimated and actual row counts in execution-plan output, plans degrading immediately after bulk loads or partition exchanges, catalog views showing statistics-update timestamps lagging far behind the latest data-change timestamps, and recurrent statistics-changed or plan-recompile events. Possible contributing factors: high-velocity data modifications never crossing automatic-analysis thresholds on very large tables, automatic statistics collection disabled or rate-limited, bulk-load sessions suppressing automatic statistics maintenance, missing extended or multi-column statistics for correlated predicates, missing histograms on highly skewed columns, sampling rates too low to capture skew, and stale global statistics on partitioned tables after partition-level data changes.

entry.official_definition: Specifies the amount of time with no network activity after which the operating system should send a TCP keepalive message to the client.
entry.trigger_condition: A TCP client connection has no network activity longer than tcp_keepalives_idle on systems supporting TCP_KEEPIDLE or an equivalent socket option.
entry.workload_impact: Starts TCP keepalive probing for an otherwise idle client connection; together with interval and count settings this can lead to dead connection detection.
entry.default_behavior: Default value is 0, selecting the operating system default.
entry.cause_analysis: This timeout is usually triggered when connection establishment, authentication exchange, or session activity does not progress within the allowed time budget.
entry.solution_guidance: Check connection lifecycle, client responsiveness, authentication latency, idle-session handling, and whether connection pools are holding stale sessions.
